{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ScopedTypeVariables #-}
module FlashLoan.Protocol where

import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Concurrent.Async
import Control.Monad (when, unless, void)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word64, Word8)
import Data.Bits (shiftR, (.&.))
import Crypto.Hash (hash, Digest, SHA256)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BSC

type Address = BS.ByteString
type Amount = Word64
type Nonce = Word64

data PoolState = PoolState
  { poolBalance    :: !Amount
  , poolReserves   :: !Amount
  , poolNonce      :: !Nonce
  , poolLoanActive :: !Bool
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data LoanRequest = LoanRequest
  { loanBorrower :: !Address
  , loanAmount   :: !Amount
  , loanFee      :: !Amount
  , loanCallbackHash :: !(Digest SHA256)
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

newtype Pool = Pool { unPool :: TVar PoolState }

createPool :: Amount -> IO Pool
createPool initialBalance = do
  tv <- newTVarIO $ PoolState initialBalance initialBalance 0 False
  return (Pool tv)

-- Compute commitment hash for callback verification
-- Uses fixed-width big-endian encoding for Word64 fields and prefixes the
-- variable-length address with its length so the serialization is injective
-- (no ambiguous concatenation that could cause hash collisions).
computeCommitment :: Address -> Amount -> Nonce -> Digest SHA256
computeCommitment addr amt nonce =
  let payload = BS.concat
        [ encodeWord64 (fromIntegral (BS.length addr))
        , addr
        , encodeWord64 amt
        , encodeWord64 nonce
        ]
  in hash payload

-- Fixed-width, big-endian 8-byte encoding (injective, unambiguous)
encodeWord64 :: Word64 -> BS.ByteString
encodeWord64 w = BS.pack (map byteAt [7,6,5,4,3,2,1,0])
  where
    byteAt :: Int -> Word8
    byteAt i = fromIntegral ((w `shiftR` (8 * i)) .&. 0xff)

-- Verify the borrower's callback executed correctly
verifyRepayment :: Pool -> Amount -> Amount -> IO Bool
verifyRepayment (Pool tv) originalBalance expectedFee = do
  st <- readTVarIO tv
  let currentBal = poolBalance st
  -- Check that pool received back principal + fee
  return (currentBal >= originalBalance + expectedFee)

-- The flash loan execution with async callback
executeFlashLoan :: Pool -> LoanRequest -> (Amount -> IO ()) -> IO (Either String ())
executeFlashLoan pool@(Pool tv) req callback = do
  -- Phase 1: Validate and disburse
  disbursement <- atomically $ do
    st <- readTVar tv
    if poolLoanActive st
      then return (Left "Loan already active")
      else if loanAmount req > poolBalance st
        then return (Left "Insufficient pool balance")
        else do
          let newBal = poolBalance st - loanAmount req
          writeTVar tv st
            { poolBalance = newBal
            , poolLoanActive = True
            , poolNonce = poolNonce st + 1
            }
          return (Right (poolBalance st))
  
  case disbursement of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right originalBalance -> do
      -- Phase 2: Execute borrower callback asynchronously
      callbackResult <- async $ callback (loanAmount req)
      wait callbackResult
      
      -- Phase 3: Verify repayment
      -- CRITICAL: Read state and verify atomically
      result <- atomically $ do
        st <- readTVar tv
        let expectedReturn = originalBalance + loanFee req
        if poolBalance st >= expectedReturn
          then do
            writeTVar tv st
              { poolLoanActive = False
              , poolReserves = poolBalance st
              }
            return (Right ())
          else return (Left "Repayment insufficient")
      
      case result of
        Right () -> return (Right ())
        Left _ -> do
          -- Rollback: but state already modified by callback
          atomically $ modifyTVar tv $ \st -> st
            { poolBalance = originalBalance
            , poolLoanActive = False
            }
          return (Left "Flash loan failed: insufficient repayment")

-- Repay function that borrowers call
repayLoan :: Pool -> Amount -> IO ()
repayLoan (Pool tv) amount = atomically $ do
  st <- readTVar tv
  writeTVar tv st { poolBalance = poolBalance st + amount }

-- Nested borrow: enforces loan-active invariant atomically
-- This version correctly checks poolLoanActive within the same transaction
nestedBorrow :: Pool -> Amount -> IO (Either String Amount)
nestedBorrow (Pool tv) amount = atomically $ do
  st <- readTVar tv
  if poolLoanActive st
    then return (Left "Cannot borrow while loan is active")
    else if poolBalance st < amount
      then return (Left "Insufficient for nested borrow")
      else do
        writeTVar tv st { poolBalance = poolBalance st - amount }
        return (Right amount)

-- Exploit scenario: attacker callback (will fail due to guard)
exploitCallback :: Pool -> Amount -> Amount -> IO ()
exploitCallback pool loanAmt fakeRepayment = do
  -- Step 1: "Repay" with inflated amount
  repayLoan pool fakeRepayment
  -- Step 2: Attempt nested borrow - BLOCKED by poolLoanActive check
  void $ nestedBorrow pool (fakeRepayment - 1)

-- Safe usage example
safeCallback :: Pool -> Amount -> Amount -> IO ()
safeCallback pool loanAmt fee = do
  -- Honest borrower: repays principal + fee
  repayLoan pool (loanAmt + fee)
